dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: germinal-center B-cell-like (GCB) subtype by the Hans algorithm

stage_nonbulky_no_b.quote: She has no B symptoms (no fever, drenching night sweats, or weight loss).

stage_pet_no_marrow_biopsy.quote: Bone marrow biopsy is not required because PET shows no marrow uptake.

mn_overstaged.quote: even if one counted them as two cervical regions (stage II), this would remain limited-stage, non-bulky disease

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: FISH is negative for MYC, BCL2, and BCL6 rearrangements, so this is not double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma.

mn_calls_double_expressor.quote: which is below the usual thresholds for double-expressor DLBCL

prog_ipi_low.quote: The age-adjusted IPI is 0 (age <60, stage I, LDH 190 U/L [normal 135-225], ECOG 0, no extranodal sites).
prog_ipi_low.note: Reports age-adjusted IPI 0 rather than standard IPI, though all five IPI factors are listed as favorable.

tx_curative_rchop.quote: Curative-intent R-CHOP21 for four cycles, without involved-site radiation.

tx_flyer_4rchop_2r.quote: Curative-intent R-CHOP21 for four cycles, without involved-site radiation.
tx_flyer_4rchop_2r.note: Cites FLYER and gives 4 R-CHOP without RT but omits the 2 additional rituximab doses.

tx_no_rt_goals.quote: I am deliberately omitting ISRT because she has non-bulky stage I disease and strongly wishes to avoid neck radiation

tx_alternatives.quote: The main shared decision is four cycles of R-CHOP alone versus three cycles of R-CHOP plus involved-site radiation

mn_six_cycles.quote: I would not use 6 cycles of R-CHOP, Pola-R-CHP

mn_pola_preferred.quote: I would not use 6 cycles of R-CHOP, Pola-R-CHP

mn_da_epoch.quote: If a reference review unexpectedly showed double-hit lymphoma, I would use a more intensive regimen such as DA-EPOCH-R

cns_low_no_prophylaxis.quote: I would not give intrathecal methotrexate or high-dose methotrexate prophylaxis.

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: I would not give intrathecal methotrexate or high-dose methotrexate prophylaxis.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: interpreted by Lugano 2014 criteria using the Deauville 5-point scale

resp_interim_pet.quote: I would not do an interim PET outside a clinical trial.

work_pregnancy_test.quote: Before cycle 1, I still need a serum pregnancy test (she is premenopausal on a combined oral contraceptive)

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: No HBV DNA or antiviral prophylaxis is needed because she is HBsAg/anti-HBc negative and anti-HBs positive.

work_echo_reviewed.quote: Cumulative doxorubicin will be 200 mg/m2, and baseline LVEF is normal

sup_stop_coc_switch.quote: Switch to a progestin-only or non-hormonal contraceptive method and document a negative pregnancy test before R-CHOP.

sup_coc_reason.quote: Migraine with aura is a WHO category 4 contraindication to combined hormonal contraception, and active cancer plus chemotherapy further increases venous thromboembolism risk.

sup_fertility_counselling.quote: an urgent fertility-preservation consultation (oocyte/embryo cryopreservation, AMH and antral follicle count) because cyclophosphamide is gonadotoxic

fit_goals.quote: Her goals are cure, avoiding neck radiation, and continuing to teach with as few absences as possible
